acceptance: Diff-anchored findings, fresh or carried, get a finding-marker thread; backfill creates no duplicate thread on a rerun and preserves stable finding identity.

Unanchored open findings accept keyed Dispute: <finding-id> comments only from configured attesters, with the same two-round escalation and owner-adjudication rules as thread replies; unknown/stale/unauthorized disputes cannot alter disposition.

A pytest-discovered Theseus integration scenario using fake OMP/Jev/GitHub proves body-only finding, two disputes, escalation, authorized owner adjudication and exact-head gate success. A unit-only synthetic flow does not satisfy this criterion.

Merge the fixed engine and integration scenario through Theseus review; record the exact source commit and release handoff. Consumer relock and hosted activation remain required under benchbox-adopt-theseus-v025-review-guidance-20261107 before the overall reliability group is complete.
